title: FedMIX-P: Mixing Local and Global Preconditioners for Federated Vision and Language Model Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.01515v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adaptive preconditioners accelerate model training, but heterogeneous client geometries can bias federated updates even when gradients are evaluated at the same model. Round-start synchronization alone cannot prevent this mismatch from reappearing during local training. We propose \texttt{FedMIX-P}, which mixes shared and local preconditioners at every local step, retaining local adaptation while reducing mean-squared operator mismatch by a factor of $\lambda^2$. For smooth nonconvex objectives with stochastic gradients and partial participation, we establish an $O(R^{-1/2})$ stationarity bound using suitable stepsizes and a horizon-dependent mixing weight, without requiring local preconditioners to converge to one another. A two-client counterexample shows that fixed positive mixing can preserve a nonstationary fixed point. The theory covers bounded linear symmetric positive-definite preconditioners. translated_title: FedMIX-P：混合局部与全局预条件子用于联邦视觉与语言模型训练
translated_abstract: 自适应预条件子可以加速模型训练，但即使梯度是在同一模型上计算的，异构客户端的几何特性也可能使联邦更新产生偏差。仅在每轮开始时进行同步无法阻止这种失配在本地训练过程中再次出现。我们提出 FedMIX-P，它在每个本地步骤中将共享预条件子与本地预条件子进行混合，在保留本地适应性的同时将算子失配的均方值降低 λ² 倍。对于具有随机梯度和部分参与机制的平滑非凸目标函数，我们在采用合适步长和依赖于视野长度的混合权重的条件下，建立了 O(R^{-1/2}) 的驻点界，且不要求各本地预条件子彼此收敛。一个双客户端反例表明，固定的正混合权重可能保留一个非驻点的不动点。该理论适用于有界线性对称正定预条件子。基于 SOAP、Sophia 等（摘要在此处截断）的实验……
tldr: 提出联邦训练方法 FedMIX-P，在每个本地步骤中混合共享与本地预条件子，在保留本地自适应能力的同时将算子失配均方值降低 λ² 倍，并在随机梯度和部分参与下为平滑非凸目标建立了 O(R^{-1/2}) 的驻点收敛界。
en_tdlr: FedMIX-P mixes shared and local preconditioners at every local step to retain local adaptation while reducing mean-squared operator mismatch by a factor of λ², and establishes an O(R^{-1/2}) stationarity bound for smooth nonconvex objectives with stochastic gradients and partial participation.
